who_we_are_text: We are a district-wide PTO, consisting of HVRSD parents, educators, and students, from all of the district’s schools. It also includes community allies who share our mission and vision. Mullet meeting style. We use a governance structure called Sociocracy to encourage you.
mission_subtitle: Our mission is to gather and mobilize the HVRSD educational community to actualize the District’s aspirations for youth and earth wellbeing

mission_items.title: Everyone has a voice, and power is shared
mission_items.text: Truly, even down to our governance structure of Sociocracy

mission_items.title: We're here to make an impact
mission_items.text: Our goal is not to complain or offload to-do lists. We plan to offer proposals and solutions that we are personally willing to help succeed

mission_items.title: We welcome opposing ideas and opinions
mission_items.text: When we encounter folks who spotlight our differences and cast us as opponents, we stubbornly spotlight  common interests and welcome them as allies

contact_subtitle: Have questions about ecoPTO? We'd love to hear from you. Send us a note and one of our members will be in touch shortly.
title: Homepage
hero_subtitle: We envision our youth  boldly reshaping the culture and physical landscape of New Jersey, and the planet, for the better
events_subtitle: Join us for workshops, community actions, and family-friendly events.
